Lacking the ability to cut easily; not sharp.

examples.text: All these knives are dull.

glosses: Boring; not exciting or interesting.

examples.text: He sat through the dull lecture and barely stayed awake.

examples.text: This people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing.

To render dull; to remove or blunt an edge or something that was sharp.

examples.text: Years of misuse have dulled the tools.

glosses: To soften, moderate or blunt; to make dull, stupid, or sluggish; to stupefy.

examples.text: He drinks to dull the pain.

examples.text: A razor will dull with use.
